notes.title: 🎪 The Hardcore Circus Demo is out now! 🎪
notes.content:
Proud to announce the release of demo of another title called Hardcore Circus - punishing precision-platformer.

Check the free demo out if you like precision-platformers!

After months of hard work, blood and sweat, I'am thrilled to invite you to the most unforgiving precision-platformer out there.

WARNING: Game may cause sweaty palms, uncontrollable screaming and emotional rollercoaster 💀

🎪  GAME HIGHLIGHTS
✅ Pure Platforming Mastery: A no hand-holding challenge where every jump must be flawless.
✅ Environmental Obstacles: Die, retry, repeat through handcrafted hardcore challenges featuring portals, sawblades, portals, trampolines, sharks, elephants, spiders and many more.
✅ Boss Battles: Face unbelievable bosses with only movement and environment at your disposal.
✅ Global Leaderboard: Compete against players worldwide in the Best Time Demo Leaderboard and showcase your speedrunning prowess.

"Hardcore Circus is a love letter to precision platforming - where every death teaches you something. The demo is just a taste of the agony and euphoria... both at the same time, multiple times in a row."

🎮 PLAY NOW ON STEAM:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308330/Hardcore_Circus/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308330/Hardcore_Circus/[/url]

A HUGE THANK YOU to the playtesters, supporters and everyone who shared the info about the game.

notes.title: Pandemia new "Create Vaccine" Arcade Puzzle Mode
notes.content:
2 in 1, Play Become a World Leader mode or Create Vaccine mode.

World Leader Mode:

Swipe cards to face the deadly virus threat in this story driven strategy game.
Step into the world where you will make decisions that world leaders make in the event of a deadly virus threat. Remember, every decision has it’s instant or postponed consequences.

Use a strategic map to influence your decisions to manage the virus outbreak. Manage your finances, people mood and virus research to make balanced decisions.

Create Vaccine Mode:

Become a Scientist and create a Vaccine in this arcade puzzle solver mode.
Match Nucleobases into Nucleotides and try to get the highest score.
Finish increasingly hard levels in this infinite puzzle mode.
